full_name: Jerold C. Frakes | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Humanities Carl and Lily Pforzheimer Foundation Fellow University at Buffalo
bio: Jerold C. Frakes is a professor of English at the University at Buffalo. His research is in the field of medieval European literatures, especially German, Latin, Norse, and Yiddish.
